scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from character orthogonality and the published sharp inequality; 1069 finite computational checks are corroboration, not an unrestricted certificate.
scientific_limitations: Local to individual quadratic-character lines in fields of characteristic greater than three; field-uniform radius is sufficient, not optimal; complete global extremizer classification and independent scientific audit are not claimed.
title: Field-uniform quantitative stability for sharp finite-field parabolic extension
